parameters.content:
## Decision router

Every button press on an approval card. Answers Slack with an empty 200 first, then verifies the request signature (5-minute window) and routes by action: details opens a modal; decide opens a steer modal and, on submit, records the decision with the optional steer and rewrites the card; ack or snooze records one tap; session queues a follow-up request and confirms in the thread.
